2
Asɔfoɔ no asotwe
1Na afei, deɛ wɔahyɛ yi, wɔne mo, asɔfoɔ. 2#Deut 28.15 Sɛ moantie na moamfa anhyɛ mo akoma mu sɛ mode animuonyam bɛma me din a, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ, ɛnneɛ mɛma nnome aba mo mu, na madome mo nhyira no; anokwa, madome wɔn dada, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnyɛ nnipa a wɔde m’asɛm sie wɔn akoma mu. 3Hwɛ, mɛtwi mo asefoɔ anim, na mabɔ sɛbeɛ mapete mo anim, mo nnapɔnna sɛbeɛ no, na wɔasesa mo aka ɛno ho akɔ; 4na mobɛhunu sɛ me na mesoma maa wɔde mmara yi brɛɛ mo sɛ ɛnyɛ me ne Lewi apam, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 5M’apam no yɛɛ no nkwa ne asomdwoeɛ, na mede memaa no sɛ ɔnsuro. Na ɔsuroo me, na me din nti ne ho popoe. 6Nokorɛ mmara daa n’anomu, na wɔanhunu n’anomu kɔntɔnkyesɛm biara; asomdwoeɛ ne tenenee mu na ɔne me nanteeɛ, na ɔdanee nnipa pii firi amumuyɛ ho. 7#Deut 33.10; Hag 1.13 Na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ ano kora nimdeɛ, na wɔnyɛ nhwɛsoɔ mma afoforɔ, mmara no so die mu, ɛfiri sɛ asafo AWURADE bɔfoɔ ne no. 8Nanso moafiri ɔkwan no so amane, moama nnipa bebree asunti mmara no, moasɛe Lewi apam no, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. 9Enti me nso mɛma mo anim agu ase, na moabrɛ ase ɔman no nyinaa anim, sɛdeɛ monni m’akwan soɔ na mohwɛ nnipa anim, na mobu ntɛnkyea.
Awaresɛeɛ
10 # Mal 1.6; Hiob 31.15 Ɛnyɛ agya korɔ na yɛn nyinaa yɛwɔ? Ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn korɔ na ɔbɔɔ yɛn? Ɛnam deɛn so nti na onua twa onua nkontompo sɛ yɛde bɛgu yɛn agyanom apam ho fi yi? 11#Esra 9.2 Yuda atwa nkontompo na wɔayɛ akyiwadeɛ Israel ne Yerusalem mu. Na Yuda agu AWURADE kronkronbea a ɔdɔ no ho fi, na wakɔware onyame nanani babaa. 12AWURADE bɛtwa ɔbarima a ɔyɛ yei, sɛ ɔnim na ɔboapa yɛ no afiri Yakob ntomadan mu, na wapo n’ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɔde brɛ asafo AWURADE no.
13 # Mal 1.10 Na deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu yi nso moyɛ: Mode nisuo ne esu ne ahomeguo kata AWURADE afɔrebukyia so ma ɔnnane mmɛhwɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ no, nso ɔnnye mo nsam deɛ ɛsɔ n’ani bio. 14Na mobisa sɛ: Ɛnam deɛn so? Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ayɛ wo ne wo mmeranteberɛ mu yerɛ ntam danseni, ɔno na woatwa no nkontompo, nanso ɔno ne wo hokafoɔ ne w’apam yerɛ no. 15#Yes 51.2; Hes 33.24; Gye 15.5-6; 21.12 Ɛnyɛ baako na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ mo wɔ ne honhom mu? Na ɛdeɛn ntira, sɛ mobɛwo mma a nyamesuro wɔ wɔn mu. Enti monhwɛ mo ho yie mo honhom ho, na ntwa wo mmeranteberɛ mu yerɛ nkontompo. 16#Deut 24.1 Na metane awareguo, AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn na ɔseɛ, ne deɛ ɔde mmusuo kata n’atadeɛ soɔ, enti monhwɛ mo ho yie mo honhom ho, na monntwa nkontompo.
17 # Mal 3.13-14 Mode mo nsɛm hyɛ AWURADE brɛ. Nanso moka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛde hyɛ no brɛ? Sɛ mobisa sɛ: Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔyɛ wɔ AWURADE anim, na wɔn ho yɛ no anisɔ; anaasɛ: Atemmuo Nyankopɔn no wɔ he?

Na afei, deɛ wɔahyɛ yi, wɔne mo, asɔfoɔ. Sɛ moantie na moamfa anhyɛ mo akoma mu sɛ mode animuonyam bɛma me din a, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ, ɛnneɛ mɛma nnome aba mo mu, na madome mo nhyira no; anokwa, madome wɔn dada, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnyɛ nnipa a wɔde m’asɛm sie wɔn akoma mu. Hwɛ, mɛtwi mo asefoɔ anim, na mabɔ sɛbeɛ mapete mo anim, mo nnapɔnna sɛbeɛ no, na wɔasesa mo aka ɛno ho akɔ; na mobɛhunu sɛ me na mesoma maa wɔde mmara yi brɛɛ mo sɛ ɛnyɛ me ne Lewi apam, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. M’apam no yɛɛ no nkwa ne asomdwoeɛ, na mede memaa no sɛ ɔnsuro. Na ɔsuroo me, na me din nti ne ho popoe. Nokorɛ mmara daa n’anomu, na wɔanhunu n’anomu kɔntɔnkyesɛm biara; asomdwoeɛ ne tenenee mu na ɔne me nanteeɛ, na ɔdanee nnipa pii firi amumuyɛ ho. Na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ ano kora nimdeɛ, na wɔnyɛ nhwɛsoɔ mma afoforɔ, mmara no so die mu, ɛfiri sɛ asafo AWURADE bɔfoɔ ne no. Nanso moafiri ɔkwan no so amane, moama nnipa bebree asunti mmara no, moasɛe Lewi apam no, asafo AWURADE na ɔseɛ. Enti me nso mɛma mo anim agu ase, na moabrɛ ase ɔman no nyinaa anim, sɛdeɛ monni m’akwan soɔ na mohwɛ nnipa anim, na mobu ntɛnkyea.

Ɛnyɛ agya korɔ na yɛn nyinaa yɛwɔ? Ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn korɔ na ɔbɔɔ yɛn? Ɛnam deɛn so nti na onua twa onua nkontompo sɛ yɛde bɛgu yɛn agyanom apam ho fi yi? Yuda atwa nkontompo na wɔayɛ akyiwadeɛ Israel ne Yerusalem mu. Na Yuda agu AWURADE kronkronbea a ɔdɔ no ho fi, na wakɔware onyame nanani babaa. AWURADE bɛtwa ɔbarima a ɔyɛ yei, sɛ ɔnim na ɔboapa yɛ no afiri Yakob ntomadan mu, na wapo n’ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɔde brɛ asafo AWURADE no.
Na deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu yi nso moyɛ: Mode nisuo ne esu ne ahomeguo kata AWURADE afɔrebukyia so ma ɔnnane mmɛhwɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ no, nso ɔnnye mo nsam deɛ ɛsɔ n’ani bio. Na mobisa sɛ: Ɛnam deɛn so? Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ayɛ wo ne wo mmeranteberɛ mu yerɛ ntam danseni, ɔno na woatwa no nkontompo, nanso ɔno ne wo hokafoɔ ne w’apam yerɛ no. Ɛnyɛ baako na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ mo wɔ ne honhom mu? Na ɛdeɛn ntira, sɛ mobɛwo mma a nyamesuro wɔ wɔn mu. Enti monhwɛ mo ho yie mo honhom ho, na ntwa wo mmeranteberɛ mu yerɛ nkontompo. Na metane awareguo, AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn na ɔseɛ, ne deɛ ɔde mmusuo kata n’atadeɛ soɔ, enti monhwɛ mo ho yie mo honhom ho, na monntwa nkontompo.
Mode mo nsɛm hyɛ AWURADE brɛ. Nanso moka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛde hyɛ no brɛ? Sɛ mobisa sɛ: Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔyɛ wɔ AWURADE anim, na wɔn ho yɛ no anisɔ; anaasɛ: Atemmuo Nyankopɔn no wɔ he?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
